svg.text: Every structure defined in specs/MOS-RPC-SPEC.md, from the transport binding up to the parameters of a call.

g.text: inv empty packet =0D alone, link init
inv ContentLength on first frame only
inv PipeHeader and Length are xformed
inv complete on ContentLength, not LastData
inv Cmd duplicates a byte of the message
inv len <= bytes left in host block
inv malformed or index in use -> discard
inv first message on a newly opened pipe
inv sizeof =3, no reply, no state
inv sent after 300000 ms of silence
inv apply min of received and own
inv withheld table = the open is refused
inv unique per table, per pipe
inv unresolved Class -> discard, no reply
inv frames only on the referencing pipe
inv static on first block only
inv 0x87 present even when static empty
inv match the whole tag byte, never bit 6
inv repeats to end of field
inv codec undefined here, agreed out of band
inv unknown descriptor ignored, parse on
inv sequence ends 88 then a 87 86 block

svg.text: one reply field each, in order
Abstract data model — state each peer keeps, not bytes on the wire

g.text: inv no sequence, window or timer
unsigned int, byte order in suffix
the enclosing structure names it, same bytes
the sender writes the value a second time

svg.text: Filled diamond = composition. Dashed arrow = one refers to or is assembled into the other. Hollow triangle = the discriminated variants of the parent, labelled with the value that selects each one. Each box carries its layer twice: the hatch of its left spine and the word in its header.

CLIENT, SERVER or BOTH in a header names the side that puts those bytes on the wire; data types and the abstract data model carry no badge. ↑ on a field row means the value belongs to the enclosing structure and is shown again for context, not written again; ×2 means the sender really does write it twice.
